scope: WhatsApp Business app Coexistence implementation; local database and simulated Meta callbacks
browser_scenarios: Existing Business app connection requires the international number and hides the new-number PIN
Launch includes the Coexistence feature and session-info version 3
Untrusted postMessage origins cannot complete setup
WABA-only completion works and duplicate callbacks submit once
Standard Cloud API setup still uses its original launch and PIN flow
Contact and history progress, pending batches and unmatched contacts are visible
meta_read_only_check: The active whatsapp_business_account subscription contains messages, account_update, history, smb_app_state_sync and smb_message_echoes
limitations: No real phone number was onboarded or deregistered during this validation
The user's screenshot still shows App Review incomplete; code and subscriptions do not establish Meta Coexistence eligibility
History media uses captions and placeholders; automatic media downloading is not implemented
Phone-less identities remain private support records and cannot activate guest actions or consent
